mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate (measured as the 6-month change in FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary cycle that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when the 6-month change in FEDFUNDS is positive (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 300 (as of t-1mo) signals persistent inflation that triggers a monetary policy response, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 300 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS above 5.0% and CPIAUCSL above 300 signals a high-inflation, tightening monetary cycle that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and CPIAUCSL > 300 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 3.5% (a low-unemployment regime), the tight labor market fuels inflation and triggers a monetary policy response that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 3.5 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (as of t-2mo) signals a weakening economy that triggers a flight to safety and negative equity returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1600 (as of t-2mo) signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1600 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of housing starts (HOUST) below 1600 and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) below 680000 signals a severe housing market downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST < 1600 and RSAFS < 680000 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) from its previous quarter (as of t-6mo) signals an economic slowdown that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 declines from its previous quarter (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
